## Checklist

- [ ] I read `AGENTS.md` and the relevant specifications/ADRs.
- [ ] I kept core workflows local-first with no mandatory account, telemetry, paid API, or hosted model.
- [ ] I validated external input and do not log/export secrets or raw sensitive rows.
- [ ] I added success, edge, failure, and integration/contract tests proportional to risk.
- [ ] Learned preprocessing is fit on training data only; evaluation partitions remain uncontaminated.
- [ ] Repairs require explanation and approval and create an event/stale propagation where applicable.
- [ ] UI changes are keyboard accessible, have visible focus, use no color-only state, and honor reduced motion.
- [ ] I updated docs, status labels, changelog, schemas/migrations, and citations/notices as needed.
- [ ] Methodology changes include references, independent expected values, limitations, and qualified review request.
- [ ] I disclosed material generated-code/tool assistance and verified every submitted line/result.
- [ ] All applicable lint, type, test, and build commands pass locally.
